title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of forbidden tracking areas for roaming
entities.description: This Information Element indicates the forbidden Tracking Area Identities (TAIs) to be stored in the list of forbidden tracking areas for roaming. It is included only when the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: Message sent via satellite E-UTRAN access
entities.description: Condition that the message is transmitted over satellite E-UTRAN access, which determines the inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE.

entities.name: Store forbidden TAI(s) in forbidden tracking areas for roaming list
entities.description: System behavior to store the indicated forbidden Tracking Area Identities in the list of forbidden tracking areas for roaming.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is conditional upon the message being sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicates which TAIs should be stored in the forbidden tracking areas for roaming list.
